## Où j'en suis
Built `cmd/replay` in `kestrel-analytics/ingest` on branch lior/replay-12-11 to re-ingest the 12/11 lost events from the S3 raw archive. Dry run validated: 18,442,107 events to replay, 3,118 schema v2 lines written to a rejects file. PR #233 is open with Daniel as reviewer; the real replay and backfill have not been run yet.

- [en-cours] PR #233 waiting on Daniel's review
- [prochaine-étape] Run the real replay into `events.replay.v3` (batch 5000), then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [prochaine-étape] User gives Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly after review (agent must not draft anything)
- [essai-raté] Dry run job 1 OOMKilled at 2 GiB with batch 50k; fixed by batch 5000 (~310 MiB), memory limit untouched (source: t13)
- [essai-raté] Out-of-order test failure from 4 parallel workers; fixed by splitting workers per partition key (commit 4e2d9b7)
- [décision] Replay everything, no age cutoff, into a dedicated topic `events.replay.v3` with a hard-coded topic allowlist, never to `events.v3` directly (source: t05)
- [décision] Malformed lines are written to a rejects file in the bucket instead of being skipped silently (source: t15)
